title: Round-Up Micro-Savings Total
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn
| eval roundup=ceiling(amount)-amount
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(roundup) as saved by _time
| sort - _time
description: Adds up the spare change from rounding each purchase up, showing how painless micro-saving accumulates.
value: Round-up saving is invisible yet surprisingly effective; totalling it proves small change becomes real money.
implementation: Compute per-transaction round-ups in `index=personal`; schedule monthly and total the savings.
visualization: Column chart of monthly round-up savings.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up the small change from rounding purchases up, showing how painlessly little savings grow.
